newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH Alert - Targets on three banks raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH Alert - Targets on three banks raised.

text.p: -- Ryan, Beck & Co said it raised targets on three bank stocks
-- Analyst Elizabeth Summers said upside potential exceeds downside risk for First Union Corp, Fleet Financial Group Inc and PNC Bank Corp
-- New targets are $84/shr for First Union, $59/shr for Fleet and $43/shr for PNC

-- Analyst said targets calculated by applying 1997 multiples to 1998 estimates. Excluding merger-related charges and one-time SAIF assessments, 1998 estimates are $7.65/shr for First Union, $5.25/shr for Fleet and $3.55/shr for PNC
